notes.usage: Load once when user opens a client from the directory; refresh sections via strict sub-endpoints if needed.
notes.heavy: Sections notional + realisedFy are expensive; enable with ?heavy=1 or include=...,notional,realisedFy
notes.bookSchemes: book section returns summary only unless bookSchemes=1.
notes.sipStp: sip + stp sections read InvestorSystematicPlans (Dynamo Query on clientRefNo). sipType/stpType: live|all — live keeps isLive rows only (status LIVE and lifecycle not ended).
notes.transactions: transactions section returns newest-first rows up to transactionLimit (default 10000, max 25000); full book is on GET …/transactions.
